definition: to not be available in a shop right now
description: In a small shop with tall wooden shelves packed with jars of jam and tins, a brass lamp and a brass ladder, there is an empty gap in the middle of one shelf where the jars have run out, and a grey cat lies curled up in it. A hand in a rust knitted sleeve with a silver bracelet reaches up towards the gap. The cat wakes, yawns widely and settles down again, and the hand moves down to the jars on the shelf below. Small brown mosaic tiles cover the wall under the shelves.

to reach up towards the cat
